key_issues: No clear bypass mechanism such as a skip link to main content (WCAG 2.4.1)
fix_strategy: Wrap the primary content in a single <main> landmark with an id
Add a keyboard-accessible skip link that becomes visible on focus and targets the main landmark

changes.what_changed: Added a meaningful <title> element to the document head.
Wrapped the page content in a single <main id="main-content"> landmark.
Added a 'Skip to main content' link that is visually hidden until focused and points to #main-content.
